messages.subject: Re: error in BiogeoBEARS
parts:
Hi Julian,

You are getting this error, just translated:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/biogeobears/nan$20function$20call/biogeobears/U1rFQPYy6G8/82VWzEMelCMJ

Error in rexpokit::expokit_dgpadm_Qmat(Qmat = Qmat, t = times, transpose_needed) : 
  NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 4)


Also, when you get the NaN crash, then you will not get stored results for that model, so the AIC calculations etc. at the end will not work.

So, you should adjust the min/max for DIVALIKE+J etc.  Also, run the models one-at-a-time, if you just copy-paste all six models at once, you won't see which models worked and which didn't. Once you get one model working, go on to the next.  You can set runslow=FALSE for a model after it has worked once, then you don't have to keep re-running it.

Cheers!
Nick
